propositions: The overlap judge re-sends the query ticket digest verbatim in the user message on every call within a batch, consuming full-price input tokens that could be cached if relocated to the system prompt

Hoisting the query digest from per-call user message to the shared system prompt enables Anthropic prompt caching of that invariant content, requiring only a keyword-only `shared_side` argument on `judge_one` and two module-private helpers

The measured cache floor for `anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6` is 1024 tokens, not the 4096 constant documented for Opus, and the proposed hoisted prefix reaches only 846 tokens measured, resulting in zero cache hits and a measured +936 token regression on the test corpus
Precision is preserved across the relocation: all 12 ordered-pair verdicts (relation, shared_artifact, confidence) remain identical between the inline-digest baseline and hoisted implementation

The sequential judge loop must be preserved until caching reaches the 1024 floor, because parallelizing cold calls that share a prefix would cause all N calls to cache-write instead of 1 write + N-1 reads, making it a cost regression
